swaggerUrl.description: URL of the OpenAPI document. Set this or swaggerContent.

swaggerContent.description: The OpenAPI document as a JSON string. Used instead of swaggerUrl when both are set.

headers.description: Newline-separated Name:Value lines. A value of exactly %ASSETS/<asset-name>% is replaced by that Orchestrator asset's value, from the server's folder, each time the header is sent. Sent with the spec download and every API call.

useRelay.description: Download the spec and call the API through UiPath Relay, for hosts in a private network.
